questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{B1}&\text{B2}\\\hline\text{Market}&0825&0920\\\text{Station}&0850&0950\end{array}$.
How long does B2 take from Market to Station?

options.why: Uses B1's times, $0825$ to $0850$, instead of B2's times.
Counts from $0900$ to $0950$ instead of starting at B2's departure time of $0920$.

questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{C1}&\text{C2}\\\hline\text{Start}&1240&1315\\\text{Finish}&1330&1400\end{array}$.
How long does C1 take?

options.why: Subtracts the whole HHMM entries as ordinary integers, $1330-1240=90$, instead of calculating elapsed time.
Uses only the minutes from 1:00 to 1:30 and omits the first 20 minutes.

questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|ccc} &\text{S1}&\text{S2}&\text{S3}\\\hline\text{Depart}&0750&0825&0900\\\text{Arrive}&0835&0910&0945\end{array}$.
Which is the latest service that arrives by $9{:}20\text{ am}$?

options.why: Chooses the earliest service that meets the deadline instead of the latest departure.
Checks that S3 departs before $0920$ instead of checking its arrival, which is $0945$.

questions.solution_text:
S1 and S2 arrive by $0920$; S3 arrives too late.
S2 leaves later than S1, at $0825$.
The latest service is **S2**.

questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|cc} &\text{B1}&\text{B2}\\\hline\text{Gallery}&1540&1710\\\text{Station}&1650&1820\end{array}$.
Ava arrives at the gallery bus stop at $3{:}18\text{ pm}$. How long does she need to wait for the next bus?

options.why: Counts from $1500$ to $1540$ instead of starting at Ava's arrival time of $1518$.
Calculates the wait until B2 at $1710$, overlooking the next bus at $1540$.
Uses B1's Station arrival at $1650$ instead of its departure from Gallery at $1540$.

questions.solution_text:
The next bus leaves Gallery at $1540$.
$1518\to1540=22\text{ min}$
Ava waits $22\text{ min}$.

questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|ccc} &\text{F1}&\text{F2}&\text{F3}\\\hline\text{Leave}&2250&2330&2350\\\text{Arrive}&2335&0020&0045\end{array}$.
F2 and F3 arrive on the next day. How long does F2 take?

options.why: Counts only the time from midnight to $0020$, omitting the $30\text{ min}$ before midnight.
Counts only the time from $2330$ to midnight, omitting the $20\text{ min}$ after midnight.
Uses F3's times, $2350$ to $0045$, instead of F2's times.

questions.question_text:
Use $\begin{array}{c|ccc} &\text{A}&\text{B}&\text{C}\\\hline\text{Leave}&1015&1045&1120\\\text{Arrive}&1130&1140&1205\end{array}$.
How long does service A take?

options.why: Subtracts the whole HHMM entries as ordinary integers, $1130-1015=115$, then treats the result as $115\text{ min}$.
Uses service B's times, $1045$ to $1140$, instead of service A's times.
